suitable_soil: Deep clayey loam or alluvial soil with high water retention capacity.
water_requirement: High (1200 - 1500 mm per crop cycle). Requires standing water or saturated soil during vegetative phase.
irrigation_guidance: Maintain a 2-5 cm shallow water layer during tillering and flowering. Alternate wetting and drying (AWD) can be used to conserve water without sacrificing yield.
growth_conditions: Warm and humid tropical climate, high sunlight, abundant water supply.
uses: Staple cereal food grain, rice bran oil, livestock fodder, industrial starch.

suitable_soil: Well-drained fertile loamy or clay loam soil with good humus content.
water_requirement: Moderate (450 - 650 mm per season). Critical irrigation at Crown Root Initiation (CRI) and Tillering.
irrigation_guidance: Water at key growth stages: CRI (21 days post sowing), tillering, jointing, flowering, and dough stage. Avoid waterlogging.
growth_conditions: Cool winters during growth, warm dry weather during grain ripening and harvest.
uses: Flour for bread, flatbreads (roti, naan), pasta, cereal products, livestock feed.

suitable_soil: Deep, well-drained, rich fertile loamy soil with high organic matter.
water_requirement: Moderate to High (500 - 800 mm). High water sensitivity during tasseling and silking.
irrigation_guidance: Irrigate immediately after sowing if soil is dry. Crucial moisture needed during tasseling (40-50 days) and cob filling.
growth_conditions: Warm climate with adequate sunshine, sensitive to waterlogging and frost.
uses: Human food (sweet corn, flour), poultry & animal feed, starch extraction, biofuel/ethanol production.

suitable_soil: Well-drained fertile loamy to sandy loam soils rich in organic matter.
water_requirement: Moderate (450 - 700 mm). Critical water periods are flowering and pod filling.
irrigation_guidance: Ensure adequate moisture during pod formation and seed filling. Avoid moisture stress in early flowering.
growth_conditions: Warm subtropical climate with moist, fertile soil and full sun.
uses: Soybean oil extraction, high-protein meal for livestock, tofu, soy milk, industrial bio-products.

suitable_soil: Deep black cotton soils (vertisols) or well-drained alluvial loams with good water retention.
water_requirement: Moderate to High (700 - 1200 mm). Needs dry sunny weather during boll opening.
irrigation_guidance: Irrigate at intervals of 15-20 days depending on soil type. Avoid excess moisture during boll ripening.
growth_conditions: Long frost-free period, abundant sunshine, warm temperature.
uses: Textile fiber, cottonseed oil, cottonseed meal for cattle feed.

suitable_soil: Well-drained light sandy loam or loamy soils rich in calcium and organic matter.
water_requirement: Moderate (500 - 700 mm). Pegging and pod formation stages are most critical.
irrigation_guidance: Light irrigation at flowering and peg insertion into soil is mandatory for high yield. Avoid heavy watering prior to harvest.
growth_conditions: Warm tropical/subtropical weather with loose soil allowing easy peg penetration.
uses: Edible oil, roasted peanuts, peanut butter, livestock meal.

suitable_soil: Well-drained light to medium black soils, silt loams or clay loams. Sensitive to waterlogging.
water_requirement: Low (300 - 450 mm). Tolerates drought well; excessive moisture promotes vegetative growth at cost of yield.
irrigation_guidance: Usually grown under residual moisture. One pre-flowering and one pod development irrigation if water is available.
growth_conditions: Cool dry winter climate with clear sunshine.
uses: Whole pulses, split dal (chana dal), besan (gram flour), green pods as vegetable.

suitable_soil: Well-drained loamy to sandy loam soil with good organic content.
water_requirement: Low to Moderate (350 - 500 mm). Short duration crop (60-70 days).
irrigation_guidance: Irrigate at flowering and pod development. Stop watering 10 days before harvesting.
growth_conditions: Warm humid weather, short duration, flexible intercrop.
uses: Split pulse (mung dal), sprouts, soups, traditional dishes, green manure crop.

suitable_soil: Heavy black clay soils or fertile loams with adequate drainage.
irrigation_guidance: Ensure adequate moisture at flowering and grain formation. Avoid standing water.
growth_conditions: Warm and moist climate during growth, dry weather during harvest.
uses: Split pulse (urad dal), idli/dosa batter ingredient, papad production, green manure.

suitable_soil: Light to medium loamy soil with clean drainage and low salinity.
water_requirement: Low to Moderate (250 - 400 mm). Highly water-efficient rabi crop.
irrigation_guidance: First irrigation 30-35 days after sowing (flowering stage). Second irrigation at pod filling (60-65 days).
growth_conditions: Cool temperate climate during early growth, dry bright weather during seed maturity.
uses: Mustard oil extraction, condiments/spices, oilcake for cattle feed, green leafy vegetable (sarson ka saag).

suitable_soil: Deep, fertile, well-drained loamy or alluvial soils with high water holding capacity.
water_requirement: Moderate (500 - 650 mm). High response to irrigation at bud formation and seed setting.
irrigation_guidance: Irrigate at critical stages: button stage (30 DAS), flowering (45-50 DAS), and grain filling (65-70 DAS).
growth_conditions: Warm climate, neutral to slightly alkaline soil, full sunshine.
uses: High-quality edible oil extraction, bird seed, snack seeds.

suitable_soil: Well-drained fertile sandy loam to clay loam soils rich in organic humus.
water_requirement: Moderate to High (400 - 600 mm). Consistent moisture prevents fruit splitting and blossom end rot.
irrigation_guidance: Keep soil evenly moist. Drip irrigation is highly recommended to prevent leaf wetness and fungal diseases.
growth_conditions: Warm sunny days, moderate night temperatures, frost-free weather.
uses: Culinary vegetable, tomato paste, ketchup, sauce, fresh salads.

suitable_soil: Well-aerated loose friable sandy loam rich in organic matter.
water_requirement: Moderate (400 - 600 mm). Requires constant moisture during tuber initiation.
irrigation_guidance: Frequent light irrigations. Avoid heavy soaking to prevent tuber rot and scab.
growth_conditions: Cool temperatures, short sunlight hours for tuberization, friable loose soil.
uses: Staple vegetable, starch production, potato chips, processed frozen food.

suitable_soil: Well-drained fertile sandy loam or black loamy soil rich in organic manure.
water_requirement: Moderate (450 - 650 mm). Extremely sensitive to waterlogging.
irrigation_guidance: Irrigate when topsoil dries. Avoid water stagnancy around roots to prevent wilt.
growth_conditions: Warm sunny weather, moderate humidity, frost-free climate.
uses: Spice condiment (powder/whole), fresh culinary green chilli, oleoresin extraction.

suitable_soil: Deep, fertile, well-drained silt loam or clay loam soils.
water_requirement: Moderate to High (500 - 750 mm). Continuous fruit picking requires steady moisture.
irrigation_guidance: Irrigate every 3-4 days in summer, 7-10 days in winter. Ensure proper ridge drainage.
growth_conditions: Warm long summer climate, warm night temperatures.
uses: Culinary vegetable (curries, roasted baingan bharta, stews).
